story: Big oil will die when it becomes cheaper to hail an electric self-driving car
text: Tesla batteries can be swaped. They have a video showing it, and a single station doing it, but there is no need for it atm. Ive been driving my Model S for 2+ years now, and the charging options are plenty. Link to video of battery swap [VIDEO]

story: Germany will require all petrol stations to provide electric car charging
text: Battery swap station: [VIDEO] I'm not sure why this is a not reality yet. When this happens, I will certainly not be the one refuelling my car at -30C in the winter, I will be seated in my electric car waiting for the swap to complete.
